summary: Software Engineer with 2.5 years of experience building applied AI systems, backend tooling, and engineering distributed enterprise platforms across 90+ client environments. Experienced in Python, SQL, Spark, ANTLR, orchestration, APIs, and LLM-based workflows, with a track record of owning production systems from architecture through stabilization.

projects.name: Centralized Continuous Monitoring (CCM)
achievements: Engineered the centralized ETL architecture as sole engineer, resolving production reliability and data correctness failures affecting 90+ enterprise client environments.
Accelerated client deployment speed - achieving a 98% overall onboarding reduction (15 days to <3 hours) across two architectural iterations by eliminating client-side manual configuration.
Owned engineering coordination for production onboarding and stabilization across 90+ enterprise environments, resolving cross-environment issues without a dedicated support team.
Authored the complete product TDD and user documentation, reducing onboarding-related support tickets and engineering dependency.
Spearheaded the strategic migration of 7 enterprise ETL workflows from legacy SSIS to a Kubernetes-backed Spark platform, achieving a 40% reduction in data processing time.

projects.name: DSL Tooling Engine
achievements: Architected a grammar-driven log obfuscation engine (ANTLR) that resolved a compliance-critical deployment blocker, expediting monitoring platform adoption for over 15 enterprise clients.

Designed and built a grammar-driven query decomposition engine (ANTLR) that powered performance recommendations and QA user-journey reconstruction, owning the pipeline from extraction through transformation.
Received Q1 2026 Spot Award for obfuscator delivery and orchestration migration leadership.

projects.name: Entity Ranking & Semantic Context Generation
achievements: Engineered an agentic data pipeline transforming metadata and usage logs across 4 entity types into a structured semantic knowledge layer for an AI planning agent.
Constructed a PageRank-based entity ranking engine on a bipartite graph, combining structural connectivity with behavioral usage scoring deployed across 4 prominent enterprise clients.
Implemented a two-pass LLM pipeline generating a domain-grounded semantic model, producing a 15-cluster knowledge layer covering the full planning domain.
Developed a skills-based agent framework with deterministic reasoning workflows and runtime semantic retrieval - reducing prompt sizes and driving a 60% reduction in query resolution time.

projects.name: Centralized Continuous Monitoring
achievements: Restructured platform deployment topology by building API extraction layers for centralized raw-data ingestion, eliminating per-client deployment overhead across 90+ enterprise client environments.
